summary: An adversarial probe of the sealed-circuit access guard executed one episode of the deterministic rule baseline on marine_race_horseshoe_bay.json while the guard was disabled. The guard has been fixed and the hole is now covered by tests.

what_happened.defect: final_benchmark.run_benchmark_episode carried its access-guard call inside `if False:`, so the guard was dead code. The docstring immediately above it described the guarantee in full, and the subagent that wrote the wiring self-reported the path as 'guarded with no opt-out'.
what_happened.how_it_was_found: The three adversarial verification agents for this wiring died on a session limit, so the wiring landed unverified. Rather than trust the self-report, a hand-written probe attempted four routes to a sealed circuit. Three were refused. The fourth -- a BenchmarkCase with its `official` flag cleared -- was allowed through.
what_happened.what_the_probe_did: Called run_benchmark_episode with controller `rule_gate_center_then_commit` and seed 1800 on the Horseshoe Bay circuit. The call returned without raising, so an episode was executed.
what_happened.why_the_existing_tests_did_not_catch_it: tests/learning/test_final_circuit_access_guard.py already contained two correct tests for exactly this (test_running_an_episode_on_a_sealed_circuit_is_refused and test_clearing_the_official_flag_does_not_unseal_the_track). They were not re-run after the `if False:` was introduced, and the reported pass count was stale.

containment.controller_was_not_learned: rule_gate_center_then_commit is the deterministic rule baseline. It has no learned component and no weights, so no policy could have absorbed anything from the circuit.
containment.no_result_was_recorded: artifact_dir was None and no ledger was written; `find results -name final_circuit_evaluations.jsonl` returns nothing.
containment.no_outcome_was_read: The probe discarded the return value and asserted only on whether an exception was raised. The episode's success, time, gate count and trajectory were never inspected by anyone.
containment.nothing_downstream_consumed_it: No training run, curriculum, replay buffer, checkpoint ranking, hyperparameter choice or reward decision has been made from it. The matched selection benchmark had already completed on VALIDATION seeds and is unaffected.
containment.the_learned_policy_never_touched_it: No PPO or SAC checkpoint has been run on any final circuit.

assessment: The scientific seal is intact in substance: no information about the sealed circuits entered any learned artifact or any decision. The procedural seal was nonetheless broken, because the guard that was supposed to make this impossible was disabled, and it was a probe of mine that walked through the hole. Recorded here rather than left implicit, since the value of a holdout rests on the audit trail being complete about the awkward cases as well as the clean ones.
remediation: `if False:` replaced with `if case.official or is_final_circuit(case.track):`, so the guard keys on track identity and not only on a flag a caller can clear.

All four probe routes now refuse: build_suite naming an official group, run_all via the CLI surface, run_benchmark_episode with the official flag stripped, and a non-official group still runs freely with no freeze record.

Added test_the_episode_guard_is_not_disabled, which reads the source of run_benchmark_episode and fails if the guard call is absent, sits behind a constant-false condition, or stops consulting is_final_circuit. A switched-off guard can no longer look identical to an enforced one.
Repository scanned for other disabled guards (`if False:` / `if 0:`); none found.
residual_risk: The Horseshoe Bay circuit has now been traversed once by the rule baseline within this session. If a future decision about the rule baseline's circuit performance were made, it should come from the sanctioned protocol run and not from this episode -- whose result was never captured and therefore cannot be reused in any case.
